params.body:
Shane, on the names #798 introduced: "primary klaar is 2 talen door elkaar".

He is right, and it is the worst kind of mixed naming: half English, half Dutch inside one identifier, on a public relation of the model. The house rule is identifiers in English; comments and UI copy stay Dutch.

Renamed:

| was | is |
|---|---|
| `stocklist_photo_klaar` | `stocklist_photo_ready` |
| `primary_stocklist_photo_klaar` | `primary_stocklist_photo_ready` |
| `Vehicle::afgewerkteKopie()` | `Vehicle::readyCopy()` |
| `readyCopy(..., string $tabel)` | `readyCopy(..., string $table)` |

Nothing else changes: same relations, same condition, same call sites. The comments that referred to `_klaar` now say `_ready`, and the rule text follows.

The relation was one day old and nothing outside this repository uses it, so a rename now costs nothing and a rename later costs a migration of habits.

Verified: full suite, 2.129 tests and 12.343 assertions, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project.
params.title: Rename the ready-copy relations to English
